subject: Post-demo: Draft MA Plan & credit/commit ask (FinBridge)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@finbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Draft MA Plan & credit/commit ask (FinBridge)

Hi Lisa (and Rajiv),

Thanks again for the demo this morning — appreciated the clear signals on scope and priorities. Per our call, I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) that captures the milestones we discussed, proposed owners, and a suggested target close date. High level summary below: 

- Target close: 2026-10-15 (customer readiness + procurement window)
- Key milestones: Security review completion, Pilot (2-week PoC), Pricing & contract signoff, Prod onboarding
- Redwood responsibilities: Provide SOC2 docs, sandbox for PoC, integration checklist
- FinBridge responsibilities: Procurement lead, test data access, success criteria signoff
- Dependencies: SOC2 attestation due 9/20, PoC dataset delivery by 9/24

Action items we agreed on: you to confirm internal stakeholders and procurement timeline; we to share the MAP and a pricing/credit proposal that fits a 12-month commit. 

I attached FB-MAP-v1 and a starter SOW. 

Next step: Lisa — can you confirm the procurement owner and whether a credit/commit conversation needs to be routed to procurement or finance?

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com] | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments:
- FB-MAP-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
- FinBridge-SOW-draft.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@finbridge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@finbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Draft MA Plan & credit/commit ask (FinBridge)

Jordan — thanks for the recap and the MAP. This looks like a helpful starting point. A couple quick clarifications from my side: 

- Procurement owner: Tom Ellis (copied here on his personal email for speed) — he runs purchasing and will lead contract timing.
- Finance stance: we'll need a small onboarding credit for the PoC (we typically ask for a 10-15% credit on initial committed spend) — is that something Redwood can accommodate?
- Security: SOC2 review will happen this week; I should have confirmation by 9/20.

If you can update the MAP with milestones + include a proposed credit / commit level, that will help me show this to Tom and Finance.

Best,
Lisa
VP Product | FinBridge
lisa.grant@finbridge.com

P.S. For procurement loop-in: tom.ellis@procureco.com (not copied to keep thread short).

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@finbridge.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@finbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Post-demo: Draft MA Plan & credit/commit ask (FinBridge)

Marissa/Ben — forwarding Lisa's reply. Finance at FinBridge is likely to request a 10-15% onboarding credit tied to an initial 12-month commit. I updated the MAP draft to include two pricing options: 

Option A: 12-month commit, 40M tokens/mo, 10% onboarding credit, dedicated capacity trial for PoC (standard pricing)
Option B: 18-month commit, 60M tokens/mo, 15% onboarding credit, discounted per-token rate (requires exec approval)

Attachments: FB-MAP-v2.xlsx (I highlighted the options and the recommended internal margin impact on the pricing tab). Can you please review and indicate whether we have headroom to offer Option B or whether we should position only Option A? If Option B, need an exec signoff on the higher credit + lower rate.

Note: Procurement contact is Tom Ellis (procureco). If we proceed, we'll need a short note from Ben to Marcus for pricing approval.

Thanks — Jordan

Attachments:
- FB-MAP-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet stub, updated)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@finbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Post-demo: Draft MA Plan & credit/commit ask (FinBridge)

Thanks Jordan. Quick read-through:

- Option A is safe and aligns with standard discount bands for this segment. 
- Option B gets them more favorable unit economics; margin hit is material but could be justified if we can secure the 18-month commit and expansion clauses.

Ben — can you take this to Marcus for a decision? Key ask for Marcus: approve 15% onboarding credit if we get 18-month commit and contractual guardrails (minimum monthly throughput and a 30% uplift clause after 9 months). If Marcus signs off, Legal can finalize SOW/terms and we can present Option B as the recommended plan.

Jordan — can you add explicit success criteria to milestone 2 (PoC) so FinBridge's Product and our Solutions team can score it easily?

-Marissa
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

On Mon, Sep 14, 2026 at 09:20 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> Marissa/Ben — forwarding Lisa's reply...

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing approval request: FinBridge (FB-2026-084)

Marcus — quick ask. We have a strong fit with FinBridge. Jordan attached a MAP and proposed two pricing paths: 12-month commit with 10% credit (Option A) or 18-month commit with 15% credit and a lower per-token rate (Option B).

Numbers & constraints: 
- Option A: estimated ARR year-1 $420k, 10% credit cost to Redwood = $42k (one-time onboarding credit applied over first invoice cycle)
- Option B: estimated ARR year-1 $510k, 15% credit + lower unit cost reduces margin; incremental elasticity on renewal could be +30% ARR if they expand after PoC

Ask: approve Option B (15% onboarding credit + discounted unit cost) provided Marcus can accept the contractual guardrails Marissa recommended (min monthly throughput + 30% uplift clause). If not approved, we will present Option A. 

Timing: Need an answer today to hit procurement windows (Tom expects procurement review by 9/20). Jordan — can you confirm the PoC success criteria are updated?

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: FB-MAP-v2.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing approval request: FinBridge (FB-2026-084)

Thanks for the context. After quick review with Finance, I can approve a constrained version of Option B: 15% onboarding credit is acceptable only if we get a signed 18-month commitment with the following conditions: 

1) Minimum monthly throughput clause (40M tokens/mo) enforced in contract.
2) 30% uplift clause at month 9 with revenue share adjustment if they do not meet uplift (to protect margin).
3) Onboarding credit amortized over first 3 invoices rather than a single refund line.
4) Legal to review final SOW & terms for escrow/termination language.

Jordan/Marissa: please update the MAP to reflect these guardrails and include the amortization schedule. Once updated, Marissa — get Legal looped; Jordan — share final MAP + SOW with Lisa and copy Tom/Procurement.

I'll approve in principle on those terms; Ben, please mark this closed and proceed.

-Marcus
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
